deploy-bot: Push started: image=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:canary-v3.4.2 sha=abcdef123456 env=canary arch=multi (amd64,arm64) job=ci/publish-images
ci-bot: Build artifacts ready, kicking off container push to registries.
deploy-bot: PUSH FAILED: ghcr.io responded 429 Too Many Requests during chunk upload. retrying with backoff (attempt 1/5). log snippet: `manifest upload chunk 3 -> 429`.
leo: @deploy-bot any ETA on retries? Can we fallback to internal mirror to avoid impacting canary traffic?
deploy-bot: Attempting mirror push to internal-registry.redwood.local (mirror) as fallback... started.
deploy-bot: MIRROR PUSH FAILED: internal-registry returned 500 on manifest validate. error: `blob referenced by manifest missing` — marking as transient, gathering manifest and blob list.
maria: Recommend pinning canary to previous tag `canary-v3.4.1` to keep canary stable while ops investigate. Change window still open ~30m.
sam: :thumbsup: agree — pin and stop rollout. @devon can you apply the pin so traffic doesn't flip mid-failure?
devon: Applying image pin now: `kubectl patch deployment inference-canary -n platform -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"image-pin":"canary-v3.4.1"}}}}}'` -> done. Canary replicas are still on canary-v3.4.1.
leo: Filing a GHCR support ticket, looks like CI parallel pushes bumped into rate limits. Also reducing parallelism in the pipeline.
deploy-bot: Retrying ghcr push with exponential backoff (sleep 45s) — attempt 2/5.
deploy-bot: PUSH SUCCEEDED TO GHCR: manifest and multi-arch manifest uploaded. digest=sha256:feedbeefc0ffee. Now copying to mirror.
ci-bot: Promoting mirror: `skopeo copy docker://ghcr.io/redwood/inference:canary-v3.4.2 docker://internal-registry.redwood.local/redwood/inference:canary-v3.4.2` -> success.
devon: Will unpin canary in ~10m and proceed with graduated rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation windows between steps. I'll run the rollout and watch SLO dashboards.
maria: Adding a note to release notes: "3.4.2 - updated push logic: prefer GHCR with mirror copy; added stronger retry/backoff and reduced pipeline parallelism to avoid GHCR rate limits."
leo: :eyes: Good catch everyone. Reopen if mirror copy shows any digest mismatch. Closing thread after full rollout complete. Thanks!
